title: 'GG EZ' and the strange journey from AI song to internet obsession
key_facts: 'GG EZ' is a short pop-rap song built on gaming slang; a 7-second clip of it has passed 72 million views on X, per Mashable.
It first appeared in May under the name M.Sasuke, an anonymous Japanese producer who says they write music with AI; that version has over 18 million Spotify streams.
The producer says they wrote the lyrics and chose the arrangement; Forbes described the vocals and music as AI-generated.
In late August creators Kaien Nuen and Angelina 'Sugar' Zhang re-recorded it with their own voices, with M.Sasuke's permission, according to Pitchfork.
The human version took off on X, with Valorant's official account and others joining the joke; some artists also remixed it.
Mashable argues the song's story shows it is hard to say who 'made' a song when a person supplies words and direction and a machine the sound.
